description: Independent positive-W polygon for A=(-.2,-.2,.1,0), B=(.8,-.7,.6,1), C=(0,.8,.6,1).
derivation: Far plane cuts A-B and A-C at t=1/5.
Bottom plane cuts A-B at t=2/5.
The far-plane edge meets the bottom plane 1/3 of the way from its A-B endpoint to its A-C endpoint.
Map the surviving polygon through viewport (7,11,100,80,.25,.75).
Colours interpolate linearly during homogeneous clipping, then use the D3D9 fixed-function perspective interpolation shared by the renderer.
